2609.02754.title: Untangling the Mechanisms of Misleading Context in Medical Question Answering
2609.02754.paper_summary: Large language models now answer medical questions with expert-level performance. However, the context these systems act on can be misleading, and misleading context can corrupt a model's medical judgment. To understand how misleading context corrupts this judgment, we examine the model's susceptibility to the context, disclosure of it, mechanism of corrupted reasoning, and monitorability of the decision. On the medical reasoning subset of MedMisBench, a clinician-reviewed question-answering benchmark of 8,627 questions, we inject two types of misleading context cues, fabricated evidence and a bare assertion. We test three reasoning models, two that expose their full reasoning trace and one frontier model that exposes only its response. All three are more susceptible to the assertion than to the fabricated evidence, adopting the asserted answer 10 to 27 points more often. The misleading cues are disclosed in 81 to 98% of traces but only 7 to 90% of responses, and the assertion is disclosed less often than evidence based cues. Resampling from reasoning traces without disclosure shows the two cues corrupt reasoning differently, evidence entering early and accumulating while the assertion redirects the conclusion near its end. An LLM monitor catches 78% of corrupted decisions at 5% false positives when reading an open model's trace with guidance, against at most 32% from any response. The misleading context that models are most susceptible to is disclosed least, and was caught reliably only from an open reasoning trace, which frontier providers withhold.
2609.02754.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型現在能以專家級的表現回答醫療問題。<lb/>然而，這些系統所依賴的背景可能會產生誤導，而誤導性的背景可能會損害模型的醫療判斷。<lb/>為了理解誤導性背景如何損害這種判斷，我們檢視模型對背景的敏感性、其披露情況、損壞推理的機制以及決策的可監控性。<lb/>在 MedMisBench 的醫療推理子集上，這是一個由臨床醫生審核的問題回答基準，共有 8,627 個問題，我們注入了兩種誤導性背景提示，虛構證據和單純主張。<lb/>我們測試了三種推理模型，其中兩種展示其完整的推理過程，另一種前沿模型則僅展示其回應。<lb/>這三種模型對於主張的敏感性高於虛構證據，接受主張的答案的頻率高出 10 到 27 個百分點。<lb/>誤導性提示在 81% 到 98% 的推理過程中被披露，但在 7% 到 90% 的回應中僅披露少數，且主張的披露頻率低於基於證據的提示。<lb/>從未披露的推理過程中重新抽樣顯示，這兩種提示對推理的損害方式不同，證據早期進入並累積，而主張則在結論接近結尾時重新導向。<lb/>一個 LLM 監控器在閱讀開放模型的推理過程時，能以 5% 的假陽性率捕捉到 78% 的損壞決策，而從任何回應中最多僅能捕捉到 32%。<lb/>模型最容易受到的誤導性背景披露最少，且僅從開放推理過程中可靠捕捉到，而前沿提供者則不予披露。
